text.tspan: Exploratory. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval over names; a cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints
its pooled count. No purchase includes refusals, errors, invalid product IDs and no tool call.
In vague requests the agent could ask twice before a scripted 'choose one yourself' reply (Deviation D1). Second-ask rates are in the CSV. n
under each panel title: names per group x runs per name. The vague-request ask rate also sits beside H4 in Figure 6 A (PLAN 10 Figure 2 panel
Color = name group (not model; the PLAN 10 model colors apply only to analyze.py's own figures); marker shape = model. Open marker: exploratory
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
